purpose: Teach: 工務/自給/話し合う/書き換え/増設/換気/量販/退社

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社改装、工務店との契約、進めろ。
lines.en: HQ remodel and contractor agreement—move forward.
lines.style: Clipped, economical. Authoritative opening. No wasted breath. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自給自足の食堂、計画段階で話し合う必要があります。
lines.en: Understood. We'll need to discuss the in-house cafeteria model during the planning phase.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Lean slightly forward—showing engagement. Measured cadence. Practical tone without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書、書き換え対応の条項、入れろ。
lines.style: Direct, no inflection wasted. Sharp articulation on 'revision.' The voice of someone used to being heard. Minimal pause between statements.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議室、増設します。換気設備も更新。
lines.en: Understood. We'll expand the meeting rooms and upgrade the ventilation systems.
lines.style: Confirm with a slight nod in the voice. Steady, methodical. Listing each task with equal weight—competence, not struggle. Even tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 量販店との取引、契約見直しを。退社時間、社員に配慮しろ。
lines.en: Review the volume-retail contracts. And make sure the team can leave on time.
lines.style: Final instruction—tone shifts slightly warmer on the second sentence. Not softening, but human. Slight pause between the two items. The voice of someone who notices what matters.
